items.title: United Rentals (URI) Stock Could Be A Bargain On Cash Flow
items.summary: United Rentals has pulled back in the short term yet still trades near the upper end of its recent range. That combination puts a spotlight on whether the current price can be explained by the cash it is expected to generate over time. With the stock now around US$973 per share, investors are increasingly asking how much of its long run share price story is already embedded in the valuation. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned about 180%, which puts a lot of history behind the move...
